trap.label: the fact that
trap.wrong: The fact of the city be growing is clear.
trap.right: The fact that the city is growing is clear.
trap.why: Em português, "o fato de a cidade estar crescendo" usa de + infinitivo. Em inglês, o substantivo é seguido de that + oração completa.

opts: There is evidence that sleep helps memory.
There is evidence of sleep helps memory.
There is evidence to sleep helps memory.

mcq.q: Complete: **The fact ___** prices rose worried everyone.
Qual é uma that-clause após substantivo?
opts: The belief that money brings joy

fix.wrong: The fact of he was late annoyed us.
fix.right: The fact that he was late annoyed us.

fix.wrong: I heard the news what she won.
fix.right: I heard the news that she won.

fix.wrong: There is a proof of the drug works.
fix.right: There is proof that the drug works.
fix.why: proof é incontável e leva that.

rewrite.prompt: Una com that: “The fact / Prices are rising.”
rewrite.answer: The fact that prices are rising

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com that: “I have no evidence of his guilt.”
rewrite.answer: I have no evidence that he is guilty.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com the fact that: “Tom is late. That bothers me.”
rewrite.answer: The fact that Tom is late bothers me.
